Studio Map

Logic and MOTU management

    No studio data yet

    Run make docs in the repo to generate docs/studio-data.js, then reload.

    Terraform your studio

    A declarative studio config: the sheet says what is plugged in where, studio-map reads the MOTU rack, shows what is different (plan), and fixes what it can (apply).

    Logic isn't marshallable

    Logic projects are binary and Logic has no scripting API, so the mix side is a build sheet: the Routing view below is what the template should look like. CueMix routing inside the 10pre is the other hand-done layer.

    Inputs

    Every recorded input: who, what, mic, preamp, patch point and stack.

    Routing

    Signal flow from the output back to every track, as the Logic template should be built.

    Commands

    The config is found from any directory: --config, $STUDIO_MAP_CONFIG, studio_config.json here or in a parent folder, then ~/.config/studio-map/ (linked by make install). The sheet path comes from "sheet" in the config, or --sheet.
